**Chinese name:** 晶晨半导体（上海）股份有限公司 (Jīngchén Bàndǎotǐ)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's most globally embedded video SoC designer — its chips run operator boxes worldwide (Netflix/Google-certified) and, from Q4 2026 batch mass production, Samsung TVs enter volume on its silicon; management says its smart-TV SoC shipments could reach roughly one-third of the global market in FY2026 (vs ~16.8% in 2025). FY2025: ¥67.93亿 revenue (+14.6%), record 174M chips; H1 2026 ¥43.91亿 (+31.9%) with net profit ¥6.11亿 (+23.0%), Q2 a record quarter (¥24.96亿 / ¥4.38亿). The Q3 2026 pre-announcement (8 October) is the sweep's standout datapoint: 9M revenue ¥70.8–71.8亿 (+39.6–41.6%), Q3 revenue ¥26.9–27.9亿 (+54.5–60.2%), Q3 net profit ¥6.49–6.99亿 (+223–248%) — and management's operational estimate that FY2026 revenue will top ¥100亿. An A+H listing is in motion: HKEX A1 refiled 12 April 2026 and CSRC overseas-listing备案 (国合函〔2026〕2027号) received 24 August.
:::

## What does this firm design?

4K/8K STB and smart-TV SoCs, edge-AI NPU platforms, vision-AI and Wi-Fi 6 connectivity chips.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2003 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | Smart set-top-box/TV SoCs (S/T lines), AIoT, smart-vision (C line), Wi-Fi 6 (W line); ~270 global operator customers |
| **Node Sophistication** | 6nm in mass production — first ARMv9-based 6nm STB SoC (~9M units 2025, 30M targeted 2026); the most advanced consumer-SoC node among the listed design houses |
